newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima rises after creditors OK restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima rises after creditors OK restructuring.

text.p: Tobishima Corp shares rose early on Tuesday morning after Monday's news that its creditors had formally agreed to a restructuring plan that would reduce its group debt to 100 billion yen, brokers said.
As of 0042 GMT, shares in the debt-burdened construction firm were up six yen at 210.

The restructuring was in line with a basic agreement Tobishima reached with its creditors in March, which included a reduction in creditors' claims against the builder to 100 billion yen from 740 billion yen.
